motivation: The pre-registered discovery assay rejected near-complete mediation because the post-terminal suffix reset left more than 20% residual effect, while its already-registered patch-by-reset interaction was positive. This follow-up narrows the claim before any confirmation outcomes are inspected.
selection_policy: all eligible registered confirmation seeds; no outcome ranking

secondary_estimands.role: effect-size boundary only; not a gate for partial mediation

allowed_claim_if_primary_confirmation_ga: A terminal trace state causally changes answer scoring in part through the post-terminal residual suffix.
additional_claim_if_answer_query_seconda: The answer-query residual itself carries a nonzero part of this mediated effect.
prohibited_claims: exclusive mediation through the answer-query token
greedy-answer control unless the supplementary greedy endpoint also supports it
